Usage: claude [options] [command] [prompt]

A stand-in for the Claude Code help text, written for runtime-agent's tests. It keeps the
shape the lane reads: options at two spaces, wrapped descriptions in a column of their own.

Arguments:
  prompt                                  Your prompt

Options:
  --add-dir <directories...>              Additional directories to allow tool
                                          access to
  --bare                                  Minimal mode, the default in print
                                          mode: skip hooks, plugins, MCP servers
                                          and CLAUDE.md discovery
  -h, --help                              Display help for command
  --include-partial-messages              Include partial message chunks as they
                                          arrive (only with --print and
                                          --output-format=stream-json)
  --mcp-config <configs...>               Load MCP servers from JSON files or
                                          strings
  --output-format <format>                Output format (only with --print):
                                          "text", "json" or "stream-json"
  --permission-mode <mode>                Permission mode for the session
  --permission-prompts <mode>             What to do with a permission prompt
                                          that nobody can answer
  -p, --print                             Print the response and exit
  -r, --resume [value]                    Resume a conversation by session ID
  --setting-sources <sources>             Comma-separated setting sources to
                                          load (user, project, local)
  --strict-mcp-config                     Only use MCP servers from --mcp-config
  --verbose                               Override the verbose mode setting
  -v, --version                           Output the version number

Commands:
  auth                                    Manage authentication
